raw_segments.text: Because I disliked you too fixedly and thoroughly ever to lend a hand in lifting you to prosperity.
I could not forget your conduct to me, Jane, the fury with which you once turned on me,
the tone in which you declared you abhorred me the worst of anybody in the world, the
unchildlike look and voice with which you affirmed that the very thought of me made
you sick and asserted that I had treated you with miserable cruelty.
I could not forget my own sensations when you thus started up and poured out the venom
of your mind. I felt fear as if an animal that I had struck or pushed had looked up
at me with human eyes and cursed me in a man's voice. Bring me some water. Oh, make haste.
